items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: Fasola was about, well, when I was playing there, Fasola was a little younger than me... He used to come around in short pants... And he played just as wonderful then as he did later on.

ctx.x: Right. I said, I said, Harry Shields was playing clarinet. Bill replaced Harry later on. That's right. Now, the point is this, Charlie, that in this place, all the musicians used to drop in, you see, because it was a meeting place. Shawky used to stop in there. Fasola. Fasola was about, well, when I was playing there, Fasola was a little younger than me. And you talk about something funny. He used to come around in short pants. And he weighed about, he weighed about 200 pounds with short pants and a cap. There…
I'm sorry, before you go on, did you mention the name of this place?
